schemaComparison.selectedCoreSurfaceObservation: No removed top-level property, required field, or enum value was observed in ThreadStart, ThreadResume, TurnStart, TurnCompleted, or ItemCompleted schemas; 0.145.0 added audio-related enum values.

rejectedHypotheses.hypothesis: A successful turn/start response means that same-thread turn was accepted for execution.
rejectedHypotheses.evidence: The second overlapping turn/start returned a turn, but emitted neither turn/started nor turn/completed. Its interrupt returned -32600 and reported the first turn as still active after the first interrupted terminal notification.

rejectedHypotheses.hypothesis: App Server stable item events make every model tool denial structured.
rejectedHypotheses.evidence: The read-only patch denial appeared on stderr and in agent text, while completed item events contained only userMessage and agentMessage.

rejectedHypotheses.hypothesis: App Server subprocesses are safe from ambient environment inheritance by default.
rejectedHypotheses.evidence: A synthetic non-secret ambient variable was visible under the default policy and absent with shell_environment_policy.inherit=none.

architectureInvariants: Agent Execution serializes turn/start per provider thread and never relies on the provider to reject or queue same-thread overlap safely.
A turn/start response is a provider observation, not AR acceptance. AR requires turn/started plus a terminal event or an explicit reconcile_required outcome.
Every provider operation is fenced by RuntimeOperation and ExecutionGeneration before dispatch; provider thread and turn IDs are routing hints only.
App Server runs behind a provider-specific anti-corruption adapter over a pinned generated schema revision.
Unknown additive notifications and fields are tolerated, but only allowlisted projections cross bounded-context or public event boundaries.
account/rateLimits/updated is tenant-private Provider Access data and is not copied into general logs or public RuntimeOperation events.
Subprocess environment inheritance is default-deny with shell_environment_policy.inherit=none plus an explicit typed allowlist.
thread/shellCommand, raw filesystem methods, config writes, plugin installs, OAuth login, and other broad App Server methods are not exposed through the Agent Execution port.
Structured command/exec results, provider notifications, stderr diagnostics, and verified filesystem/effect receipts remain separate evidence streams.
